brief.meaningEn: Match what many people are feeling or wanting at a particular time.
brief.meaningZh: 某項主張或行動剛好回應大眾當時的共同感受或需求。
brief.grammar: a campaign caught the public mood; a message catches the public mood.
brief.register: Neutral journalistic expression for collective feeling; support needs evidence. A journalist may tell an editor that a campaign caught the public mood only after citing public reactions.
brief.boundaryZh: 指當時廣泛的感受，不是只取悅一人，也不保證所有人都贊成。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 caught 當成抓住實物；應指出哪些共同關注令行動受到響應。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體公眾反應解釋一項倡議為何得到支持。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 9, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The campaign caught the public mood at exactly the right moment.

listening.en: Residents had been asking for safer crossings. When a petition for a new zebra crossing appeared, it caught the public mood and quickly gained hundreds of signatures.
listening.zh: 居民一直要求更安全的過路處。有人發起設置新斑馬線的請願，恰好切合大眾心聲，很快得到數百人簽名。
listening.promptZh: 請願為何很快得到支持？

options.en: It matched a concern shared by many residents.
options.zh: 它回應了很多居民共同關注的問題。

options.en: It was signed only by its organiser.
options.zh: 只有發起人簽了名。

options.en: It asked residents to remove all crossings.
options.zh: 它要求居民拆除所有過路處。

options.en: It addressed parking charges rather than crossing safety.
options.zh: 它處理的是泊車收費，而不是過路安全。

listening.explanationZh: 居民早已關注過路安全，數百人簽名顯示請願切合當時廣泛的訴求。

reply.promptEn: Why did the campaign to reduce food waste gain support just as residents began discussing the issue?
reply.promptZh: （居民開始討論食物浪費時，減廢活動為何得到支持？）

options.en: It offered a practical way to share unused food.
options.zh: 它提供分享剩餘食物的實際方法。

options.en: It addressed a concern many neighbours had raised.
options.zh: 它回應了很多鄰居提出的憂慮。

options.en: It caught the public mood at the right time.
options.zh: 它在合適時機切合了大眾心聲。

options.en: It gave volunteers an easy first step.
options.zh: 它讓義工有容易實行的第一步。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可合理解釋支持的原因；金句概括活動與當時大眾關注的事相呼應。

scene.promptZh: 社區居民一直抱怨巴士班次太少。一項增加晚間班次的倡議公開後，短時間得到大量支持。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The proposal caught the public mood because many residents wanted better service.
options.zh: 這項建議切合大眾心聲，因為很多居民希望改善服務。

options.en: The proposal ignored every concern residents had mentioned.
options.zh: 這項建議忽略了居民提過的所有問題。

options.en: The support came only from the one person who wrote the proposal.
options.zh: 支持只來自撰寫建議的一人。

scene.explanationZh: 大量居民先已關注班次，倡議正回應共同需求。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「切合當時廣泛感受」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 catch the public mood？

options.en: A campaign for cleaner streets gains broad support after many residents complain about litter.
options.zh: 多人投訴街道垃圾後，清潔街道活動獲得廣泛支持。

options.en: One person privately likes a poster, while nobody else has seen it.
options.zh: 只有一人私下喜歡一張海報，其他人都未看過。

options.en: An event on low-cost travel attracts large crowds during a period of rising fares.
options.zh: 車費上升期間，低成本出行活動吸引大量人參加。

contrast.explanationZh: 一人的私人喜好不足以證明大眾有共同感受；另外兩項有廣泛反應。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為何我們的舊衣交換活動這星期特別受歡迎？」你知道很多家庭正在討論減少浪費。哪個回答最準確？

options.en: It caught the public mood because many families already wanted to reuse clothes.
options.zh: 它切合大眾心聲，因為很多家庭本來就想重用衣物。

options.en: Its popularity proves every family has exactly the same view.
options.zh: 它受歡迎證明每個家庭的看法完全一致。

options.en: It became popular before anyone knew the event existed.
options.zh: 在任何人知道活動存在之前，它已經受歡迎。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已有很多家庭關注重用衣物，能合理解釋活動如何切合當時的共同想法；不代表人人意見一致。

speaking.en: The local recycling drive caught the public mood after neighbours called for less waste.
speaking.zh: 鄰居呼籲減少浪費後，這項本地回收活動切合了大眾心聲。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明回收活動為何得到回應。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：市政府打算縮短多區公共圖書館的週末開放時間。居民一直擔心學生和上班族失去自修空間；一項要求保留週末開放時間的公開聯署很快獲得數千人支持。用一至兩句英文解釋聯署為何得到支持。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出聯署回應了多區居民已有的共同關注，並說明週末圖書館開放時間的具體問題；不要只說一個人喜歡。

examples.en: The petition to keep libraries open on weekends caught the public mood because residents across the city feared losing a quiet place to study.
examples.zh: 要求圖書館週末繼續開放的聯署切合了大眾心聲，因為全市居民擔心失去安靜的自修場所。

examples.en: By defending weekend library hours, the campaign caught the public mood and gathered thousands of signatures from several districts.
examples.zh: 這項活動爭取保留圖書館的週末開放時間，切合了大眾心聲，並從多區收集到數千個簽名。

glossary.zh: 圖書館的週末開放時間

takeaways.en: The appeal caught the public mood when families were asking for safer streets.
takeaways.zh: 家庭正要求更安全的街道時，這項呼籲切合了大眾心聲。

takeaways.en: A good idea still needs evidence before we say it caught the public mood.
takeaways.zh: 要說一個好主意切合大眾心聲，仍需要證據。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.
Provisional draft pending editorial and source-sense review; no release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: In person, with the people involved physically present together.
brief.meaningZh: 雙方親身在同一地方直接交談或處理事情。
brief.grammar: talk face to face; meet face to face.
brief.register: Neutral conversational phrase; often contrasts with messages or calls. A teacher may tell two pupils that a disagreement may be easier to discuss face to face than by text.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是親身相見；視像通話雖可看到臉，仍不等於同處一室。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把每次看到別人的照片或視像畫面都當成面對面見面。
brief.outcomeZh: 能選擇適合親身討論的情況並清楚提出安排。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 10, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: We resolved the problem face to face.

listening.en: After several confusing text messages, the two volunteers met face to face at the centre and settled the delivery plan.
listening.zh: 幾則訊息令兩名義工越談越混亂，於是他們在中心面對面見面，釐清了送貨安排。
listening.promptZh: 兩名義工最後怎樣釐清安排？

options.en: They discussed it together in person.
options.zh: 他們親身相聚討論。

options.en: They stopped communicating altogether.
options.zh: 他們完全停止溝通。

options.en: They continued only by text and never met.
options.zh: 他們只繼續傳訊息，從未見面。

options.en: They asked someone to make the plan without telling them.
options.zh: 他們叫別人擅自替他們決定。

listening.explanationZh: met at the centre 表明他們親身碰面；face to face 在此不是只靠手機溝通。

reply.promptEn: How should we settle the seating plan if our messages keep causing confusion?
reply.promptZh: （若訊息反覆造成誤會，我們應怎樣敲定座位安排？）

options.en: We could compare the plan together after class.
options.zh: 我們可以下課後一起對照安排。

options.en: Let us meet face to face and draw the layout on paper.
options.zh: 我們面對面見面，在紙上畫出座位佈局吧。

options.en: We could visit the room at the same time.
options.zh: 我們可以同時到場看看課室。

options.en: We could ask the organiser to join us for a short discussion.
options.zh: 我們可以請主辦者和我們簡短討論。

reply.explanationZh: 四項都能讓相關人士直接釐清安排；金句明確用 face to face 提議親身見面。

scene.promptZh: 兩名同學用訊息討論展覽海報，對尺寸產生誤會。放學後他們在美術室見面，一起對照紙本樣稿。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They resolved the confusion face to face.
options.zh: 他們面對面地釐清了誤會。

options.en: They never met and relied only on messages.
options.zh: 他們從未見面，只靠訊息溝通。

options.en: They looked at one another’s profile pictures instead of the sample.
options.zh: 他們只看彼此的個人頭像，沒有看樣稿。

scene.explanationZh: 放學後在美術室親身看樣稿，是面對面地處理問題。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「親身在同一地方」的意思，哪個情況最不適合說 face to face？

options.en: A coach and player discuss a mistake together on the court.
options.zh: 教練與球員在球場一起討論失誤。

options.en: Two friends speak by video call from different countries.
options.zh: 兩名朋友身處不同國家，以視像通話交談。

options.en: A parent and teacher meet in the school office.
options.zh: 家長與老師在學校辦公室見面。

contrast.explanationZh: 視像通話可互相看見，但雙方沒有親身同處一室；另外兩項是當面會面。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們在群組裏越講越亂，連誰帶道具都不清楚。」哪個建議最合適？

options.en: Let us meet face to face for ten minutes and write down who will bring each prop.
options.zh: 我們面對面談十分鐘，寫下每件道具由誰帶來。

options.en: Keep sending vague messages without checking the list.
options.zh: 繼續傳含糊訊息，不用核對清單。

options.en: Cancel the performance without telling the group.
options.zh: 不用通知小組，直接取消演出。

dialogue.explanationZh: 親身快速核對道具分工，能針對群組訊息造成的混亂。

speaking.en: We talked face to face after the rehearsal and agreed on the final order of songs.
speaking.zh: 排練後，我們面對面地討論，敲定了歌曲的最後次序。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明大家如何敲定歌曲次序。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你和鄰居用訊息商量社區花園的澆水時間，但大家理解不同。你們今晚會在花園碰面。用一至兩句英文提出怎樣釐清安排。
writing.selfCheckZh: 提出親身見面時直接討論澆水時間，避免只依賴訊息；不要把視像通話說成同處一室。

examples.en: We can talk face to face in the garden tonight and agree on a watering schedule.
examples.zh: 我們今晚可以在花園面對面談談，敲定澆水時間表。

examples.en: We can meet face to face for a brief discussion and check each day on the calendar together.
examples.zh: 我們可以面對面簡短討論，一起核對日曆上的每一天。

takeaways.en: It was easier to explain the map face to face than in a long email.
takeaways.zh: 當面解釋地圖，比寫長電郵容易。

takeaways.en: The neighbours met face to face to settle the shared garden timetable.
takeaways.zh: 鄰居面對面見面，敲定共用花園的時間表。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.
Provisional draft pending editorial and source-sense review; no release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Adapt gradually as society, habits or technology change.
brief.meaningZh: 因應社會、習慣或科技的變化而調整做法。
brief.grammar: shift with the times; has shifted with the times.
brief.register: Neutral phrase for adaptation; change may preserve valued traditions. A museum guide may tell visitors how the exhibition shifted with the times while preserving old exhibits.
brief.boundaryZh: 是因應時代而改變，不是毫無理由地突然換方向，也不一定拋棄傳統。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要只列出新事物；要說清楚舊做法如何調整及為何調整。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述一項服務如何因應新習慣而改進，同時保留核心特色。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 10, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The shop has shifted with the times while keeping its name.

listening.en: The local theatre still stages live plays, but it has shifted with the times by offering online booking and captioned performances.
listening.zh: 本地劇院仍上演現場話劇，卻已隨時代改變，提供網上訂票和附字幕演出。
listening.promptZh: 劇院怎樣在保留特色之餘調整做法？

options.en: It added newer services while continuing live plays.
options.zh: 它加入新服務，同時繼續上演現場話劇。

options.en: It permanently stopped staging any plays.
options.zh: 它永久停止上演所有話劇。

options.en: It kept every process unchanged despite new needs.
options.zh: 儘管需求改變，它仍保持所有流程不變。

options.en: It changed its name but offered no new service.
options.zh: 它只改了名稱，沒有提供新服務。

listening.explanationZh: 網上訂票和字幕回應新習慣及需求，但劇院仍保留現場演出。

reply.promptEn: How has the old public library stayed useful to younger readers?
reply.promptZh: （那間舊公共圖書館怎樣繼續對年輕讀者有用？）

options.en: It now lends e-books as well as printed books.
options.zh: 它現在除了紙本書，也提供電子書借閱。

options.en: It offers online reservations for busy readers.
options.zh: 它為忙碌的讀者提供網上預約。

options.en: Its reading rooms remain, and it has shifted with the times.
options.zh: 它隨時代改變，同時保留閱讀室。

options.en: It runs workshops on digital research.
options.zh: 它舉辦數碼資料搜集工作坊。

reply.explanationZh: 四項都可解釋圖書館如何維持實用；金句概括新服務與保留閱讀室並行。

scene.promptZh: 一間家族照相館以前只收底片沖印，現在也提供數碼照片修復，仍保留暗房。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The studio has shifted with the times without abandoning its darkroom.
options.zh: 照相館隨時代改變，同時沒有放棄暗房。

options.en: The studio has never changed any of its services.
options.zh: 照相館從未改變任何服務。

options.en: The studio abandoned photography altogether.
options.zh: 照相館完全不再經營攝影服務。

scene.explanationZh: 新增數碼修復回應技術變化，保留暗房表示改變不等於放棄傳統。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「因應時代變化而調整」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 shift with the times？

options.en: A newspaper adds a mobile edition as readers change habits.
options.zh: 讀者習慣改變後，報紙增設手機版本。

options.en: A café changes its opening hours at random every day with no customer reason.
options.zh: 咖啡店每天隨意更改營業時間，與顧客需要無關。

options.en: A museum adds audio descriptions while keeping its original displays.
options.zh: 博物館保留原有展品，同時加入語音描述。

contrast.explanationZh: 每天無原因地隨意改時間，不是因應社會或顧客需求作出調整。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這間老餐廳開始接受手機點餐，是不是不再重視傳統？」餐廳仍沿用家傳食譜。哪個回應最恰當？

options.en: It can shift with the times by changing how orders are placed while keeping its family recipes.
options.zh: 它可以改變點餐方法，隨時代調整，同時保留家傳食譜。

options.en: Any new ordering method proves the food is no longer traditional.
options.zh: 只要採用新點餐方法，菜式就一定不再傳統。

options.en: The restaurant should stop serving customers to preserve its history.
options.zh: 餐廳應停止招待顧客，才能保存歷史。

dialogue.explanationZh: 點餐方式可更新，菜式傳統仍可保留；兩者並不矛盾。

speaking.en: The neighbourhood paper shifted with the times by launching a mobile edition beside its printed one.
speaking.zh: 社區報紙推出手機版本，同時保留印刷版，因而隨時代改變。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明報紙如何調整服務。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一家家庭麵包店一直用手工製作麵包。現在顧客希望早上在手機預訂，放學後才取貨。店主開設預訂服務，但繼續手工烘焙。用一至兩句英文描述改變。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出店舖回應顧客新習慣，同時保留手工製作；不要說它完全放棄原來的做法。

examples.en: The bakery shifted with the times by adding phone pre-orders while still baking bread by hand.
examples.zh: 麵包店加入手機預訂服務，同時仍手工製作麵包，因而隨時代改變。

examples.en: It has shifted with the times: customers can reserve loaves on their phones and collect them after school, while the bakery still bakes bread by hand.
examples.zh: 它已隨時代改變：顧客可以用手機預訂麵包，放學後取貨，而麵包店仍然以手工製作麵包。

takeaways.en: The cinema shifted with the times when it added accessible screenings.
takeaways.zh: 戲院增設無障礙放映場次，隨時代改變。

takeaways.en: A service can shift with the times and still keep what people value about it.
takeaways.zh: 一項服務可以隨時代改變，同時保留人們珍惜的特色。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.
Provisional draft pending editorial and source-sense review; no release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Stop being fashionable or widely favoured.
brief.meaningZh: 曾經受歡迎的款式或做法逐漸不再流行。
brief.grammar: go out of style; went out of style; never goes out of style.
brief.register: Everyday phrase for fashion, design, and popular customs. A designer may tell a client that a familiar style has not gone out of style despite newer trends.
brief.boundaryZh: 不再流行不等於完全消失或沒有品質；個人仍可喜歡它。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把個人的一時厭倦當成整個社會已不再流行。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分潮流轉變與個人喜好，避免過度概括。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 10, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Simple white shirts rarely go out of style.

listening.en: The once-popular neon phone cases went out of style, but Nadia still uses hers because she likes the bright colour.
listening.zh: 曾經流行的霓虹色手機殼不再流行，但娜迪亞仍在使用，因為她喜歡鮮艷顏色。
listening.promptZh: 手機殼的流行程度發生了甚麼變化？

options.en: The design is no longer as fashionable as before.
options.zh: 這款設計不再像以前那麼流行。

options.en: The cases have all disappeared from the world.
options.zh: 所有這類手機殼都在世上消失了。

options.en: Nadia must now dislike her own case.
options.zh: 娜迪亞現在一定討厭自己的手機殼。

options.en: The design has become popular for the first time.
options.zh: 這款設計第一次流行起來。

listening.explanationZh: 曾經流行與 went out of style 表示潮流退去；娜迪亞仍可喜歡它。

reply.promptEn: Why do people still wear that jacket design after so many years?
reply.promptZh: （為何多年後人們仍會穿那款外套？）

options.en: Its simple shape works with many outfits.
options.zh: 它的簡單剪裁能配搭很多服裝。

options.en: It is comfortable in cool weather.
options.zh: 天氣涼時穿它很舒服。

options.en: It rarely goes out of style.
options.zh: 它很少會過時。

options.en: Many people already own one and continue to use it.
options.zh: 很多人本來就有一件，並繼續穿。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理解釋這款外套長久有人穿；金句指出款式不易過時。

scene.promptZh: 一種曾在校園很流行的彩色筆袋，現在很少人在用，但有些學生仍然喜歡。哪句最貼切？

options.en: That pencil-case design has gone out of style, though some students still like it.
options.zh: 那款筆袋已不再流行，但有些學生仍喜歡。

options.en: No student could possibly still like that design.
options.zh: 絕不可能有學生仍喜歡那款設計。

options.en: The design has just become popular for the first time.
options.zh: 那款設計剛第一次流行起來。

scene.explanationZh: 使用人數大減可說不再流行，但不抹去個人的喜好。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「不再流行」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 go out of style？

options.en: A shoe shape was common last year but is rarely sold now.
options.zh: 某款鞋去年常見，現在很少有售。

options.en: A student dislikes a new coat, even though it is popular with most people.
options.zh: 一名學生不喜歡新外套，但它仍受大多數人歡迎。

options.en: An old poster style becomes uncommon as designers choose other looks.
options.zh: 設計師改用其他風格後，一種舊海報風格變得少見。

contrast.explanationZh: 一個人的不喜歡，不能證明整體潮流已經退去。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我的紅色帆布袋已經不流行了，是否一定要扔掉？」哪個回應最合理？

options.en: Even if it goes out of style, you can keep using it if you like it.
options.zh: 即使它不再流行，只要你喜歡，仍可以繼續用。

options.en: Anything unfashionable is immediately unusable.
options.zh: 任何不流行的東西都立即不能用。

options.en: Your bag must be fashionable because it is red.
options.zh: 你的袋一定流行，因為它是紅色的。

dialogue.explanationZh: 不再流行是潮流變化，不等於物品失去用途或主人必須棄用。

speaking.en: That pattern went out of style years ago, yet my aunt still loves her old coat.
speaking.zh: 那款花紋多年前已不再流行，但我阿姨仍喜歡她的舊外套。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明流行程度與阿姨喜好有何不同。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：某款厚重的相機帶曾經很流行，如今大多數攝影愛好者改用輕便款式，但你朋友仍喜歡舊相機帶。用一至兩句英文描述潮流變化及個人喜好。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出舊款不再流行，卻不等於朋友不能繼續喜歡或使用。

examples.en: The heavy camera strap has gone out of style, but my friend still likes its sturdy feel.
examples.zh: 厚重相機帶已不再流行，但我的朋友仍喜歡它結實的觸感。

examples.en: Although that old strap went out of style, she keeps using it because it feels reliable.
examples.zh: 雖然那款舊相機帶已不再流行，她仍繼續使用，因為它用起來可靠。

takeaways.en: Some trends go out of style quickly, while practical designs last longer.
takeaways.zh: 有些潮流很快過時，實用的設計則能維持更久。

takeaways.en: The poster style went out of style, but the message remained clear.
takeaways.zh: 那款海報風格不再流行，但訊息仍然清楚。

brief.meaningEn: Change direction, decision or opinion very quickly, often in response to new information.
brief.meaningZh: 因新情況而極快改變方向、決定或看法。
brief.grammar: a plan can turn on a dime; opinion turned on a dime.
brief.register: American idiom; vivid and informal in conversation, also used in commentary. A campaign analyst may tell a colleague that public opinion can turn on a dime after new evidence appears.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是改變迅速；未必是壞事，也不是字面在硬幣上轉身。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把經過長期討論的緩慢轉變說成瞬間改變。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出觸發快速改變的事件，並準確描述結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 10, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Public opinion can turn on a dime after a major event.

listening.en: The parade was set for the square, but when a storm warning arrived, the organisers turned on a dime and moved it indoors.
listening.zh: 遊行原定在廣場舉行，但暴風雨警告一到，主辦者便迅速改變安排，把活動移到室內。
listening.promptZh: 主辦者收到警告後怎樣應對？

options.en: They changed the plan almost immediately.
options.zh: 他們幾乎立即改變安排。

options.en: They spent months debating without reaching a decision.
options.zh: 他們討論了幾個月，仍沒有決定。

options.en: They kept the outdoor route despite the warning.
options.zh: 儘管有警告，他們仍維持戶外路線。

options.en: They postponed the parade for several weeks instead of moving it indoors.
options.zh: 他們把遊行延後幾星期，沒有移到室內。

listening.explanationZh: 警告一到就把活動移入室內，說明安排改得很快。

reply.promptEn: How did the exhibition team respond when the gallery lost power but the daylit foyer remained open?
reply.promptZh: （畫廊停電，但有自然光的大堂仍開放時，展覽團隊怎樣應對？）

options.en: They closed the unlit rooms until power returned.
options.zh: 他們暫時關閉沒有照明的展廳，等電力恢復。

options.en: They contacted visitors with the new location.
options.zh: 他們把新地點通知訪客。

options.en: They turned on a dime and moved the exhibition talk to the daylit foyer.
options.zh: 他們迅速改變安排，把展覽講座移到有自然光的大堂。

options.en: They used printed guides until the lights came back.
options.zh: 燈光恢復前，他們使用紙本導覽資料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都是停電後可行的應對方法；金句強調團隊立即改變安排，把講座移到仍可使用的地方。

scene.promptZh: 學校辯論賽開始前，投影機突然故障。工作人員幾分鐘內改用紙本圖表，讓比賽準時開始。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The team turned on a dime and switched to printed charts.
options.zh: 團隊迅速改變安排，改用紙本圖表。

options.en: The team made the switch only after several months of planning.
options.zh: 團隊經過幾個月規劃才改用圖表。

options.en: The event was cancelled without any alternative materials.
options.zh: 活動取消了，也沒有任何替代材料。

scene.explanationZh: 投影機突然故障，團隊幾分鐘內改用紙本圖表，符合快速轉向。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「迅速改變決定或方向」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 turn on a dime？

options.en: A team changes its route as soon as a bridge closes.
options.zh: 橋樑一封閉，團隊立即更改路線。

options.en: A council takes four years of planned consultations before gradually changing a policy.
options.zh: 議會經過四年有計劃的諮詢，才逐步改變政策。

options.en: A coach quickly changes the line-up after a player is injured.
options.zh: 球員受傷後，教練迅速更改陣容。

contrast.explanationZh: 四年內逐步變動，缺乏這個慣用語所強調的即時性。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們今晚約好在圖書館見面，但它剛宣布提早關門。」附近的咖啡店仍營業。哪個回應最實際？

options.en: We should turn on a dime and meet at the café instead.
options.zh: 我們應立即改變安排，改到咖啡店見面。

options.en: Let us wait outside the closed library without telling anyone.
options.zh: 我們不用通知任何人，只在已關門的圖書館外等候。

options.en: The closure cannot affect the plan, so we must meet inside the library.
options.zh: 關門不可能影響安排，所以我們必須在圖書館裏見面。

dialogue.explanationZh: 圖書館突然提早關門，應立即調整見面地點；金句用 turn on a dime 指快速應變。

speaking.en: The chess organisers turned on a dime when the hall became unavailable and moved the final to the library.
speaking.zh: 禮堂無法使用時，棋賽主辦者迅速改變安排，把決賽移到圖書館。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明棋賽主辦者如何迅速應變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們的社區跑步活動開始前半小時，公園突然關閉。主辦者立即改為室內步行挑戰，並傳訊息通知參加者。用一至兩句英文描述應變。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明公園突然關閉觸發即時改變，並指出新安排；不要寫成多月後才轉變。

examples.en: The organisers turned on a dime when the park closed and moved the challenge indoors.
examples.zh: 公園關閉時，主辦者迅速改變安排，把挑戰移到室內。

examples.en: After the sudden closure, the team turned on a dime, switching to an indoor walk and messaging the participants.
examples.zh: 公園突然關閉後，團隊迅速改變安排，改為室內步行並通知參加者。

takeaways.en: The coach turned on a dime after seeing the weather warning.
takeaways.zh: 教練看到天氣警告後，立刻改變安排。

takeaways.en: A team that can turn on a dime can respond quickly to new information.
takeaways.zh: 能迅速改變安排的團隊，可以快速回應新資訊。

lessons.titleZh: 撇開表面差異，深一層來看

brief.meaningEn: At a deeper level beneath visible differences or behaviour.
brief.meaningZh: 撇開表面上的差異或表現，看到較根本的感受或共同點。
brief.grammar: different habits, but underneath it all they want the same thing.
brief.register: Conversational figurative phrase; should lead to a supported deeper point. A friend may tell another friend that underneath it all, two classmates share the same worry.
brief.boundaryZh: 必須有表面與深層的對照；不是實際藏在某物下面。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要憑空替別人推斷隱藏動機；要有情境支持。
brief.outcomeZh: 能在表面分歧中，謹慎指出雙方可觀察到的共同關注。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 10, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Their customs differ, but underneath it all they share the same hopes.

listening.en: The two parents argued about the school trip route, but underneath it all they both wanted the children to travel safely.
listening.zh: 兩位家長為學校旅行路線爭論，但撇開表面分歧，他們都希望孩子能安全出行。
listening.promptZh: 兩位家長有甚麼共同的深層關注？

options.en: Both care about the children’s safety.
options.zh: 兩人都關心孩子的安全。

options.en: Neither cares where the children go.
options.zh: 兩人都不在乎孩子去哪裏。

options.en: One parent cares about safety, while the other cares only about travel time.
options.zh: 一位家長關心安全，另一位只關心車程。

options.en: They have already agreed on every route detail.
options.zh: 他們已同意路線的每個細節。

listening.explanationZh: 他們在路線上有分歧，但共同目的是孩子安全；underneath it all 指更深一層的共同點。

reply.promptEn: Why can the two volunteers work together even though one likes posters and the other prefers videos?
reply.promptZh: （兩名義工分別喜歡海報與影片，為何仍能合作？）

options.en: They both want more people to know about the food collection.
options.zh: 兩人都希望更多人知道食物募集活動。

options.en: They can use both posters and videos.
options.zh: 他們可以同時使用海報與影片。

options.en: Underneath it all, they share the aim of helping local families.
options.zh: 撇開表面差異，他們都希望幫助本地家庭。

options.en: They can divide the design work between them.
options.zh: 他們可以分工處理設計工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可解釋合作的可能；金句透過表面方法差異，指出更根本的共同目標。

scene.promptZh: 兩位學生為畢業展覽應選照片還是繪畫爭論，但他們都希望每名同學有作品展出。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Underneath it all, they share the wish to include everyone.
options.zh: 撇開表面分歧，他們都希望每個人都能參與。

options.en: They agree on exactly which art form to use.
options.zh: 他們完全同意使用哪種藝術形式。

options.en: Neither student cares whether anyone gets to exhibit.
options.zh: 兩人都不在乎有沒有同學能展出。

scene.explanationZh: 展品形式上有分歧，讓全體同學展出的目標卻一致。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「表面差異背後的深層共同點」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 underneath it all？

options.en: Two neighbours favour different garden designs but both want safe play space.
options.zh: 兩名鄰居喜歡不同花園設計，但都想要安全遊玩空間。

options.en: A lost key is physically underneath a stack of papers.
options.zh: 遺失的鑰匙實際壓在一疊紙下。

options.en: Two teammates disagree on tactics but both want the team to learn.
options.zh: 兩名隊友的策略不同，但都希望團隊進步。

contrast.explanationZh: 鑰匙在紙下是實際位置，沒有表面差異與深層共同點的對照。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「阿欣想把街市保留下來，阿明想翻新；他們是不是完全沒有共識？」你知道兩人都想讓長者容易買菜。哪個回應最準確？

options.en: Underneath it all, they both want the market to remain easy for older shoppers to use.
options.zh: 撇開表面分歧，兩人都希望街市繼續方便長者買菜。

options.en: They must agree on every renovation detail already.
options.zh: 他們一定已同意翻新的每個細節。

options.en: They have opposite views on whether older shoppers matter.
options.zh: 他們對長者是否重要持完全相反的看法。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留與翻新的方案不同，但方便長者買菜是有根據的共同關注。

speaking.en: The two neighbours disagreed about the playground design, but underneath it all they both wanted a safe space for children.
speaking.zh: 兩名鄰居對遊樂場設計意見不同，但撇開表面分歧，兩人都想給孩子一個安全的空間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明兩名鄰居共同關注甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩位朋友討論週末家庭活動。一人想去海邊，一人想去博物館；他們都說希望全家能一起度過輕鬆的一天。用一至兩句英文指出表面分歧和共同目標。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出目的地意見不同，但雙方都想與家人輕鬆相處；不要推斷他們沒有說過的隱藏動機。

examples.en: They disagree about whether to go to the beach or the museum, but underneath it all they both want a relaxed day with their family.
examples.zh: 他們對去海邊還是博物館有分歧，但撇開表面差異，兩人都想與家人共度輕鬆的一天。

examples.en: One friend suggests the beach and the other suggests a museum; underneath it all, they share the wish to spend time together.
examples.zh: 一人提議去海邊，另一人提議去博物館；撇開表面差異，他們都希望共度時光。

takeaways.en: Their methods differ, but underneath it all they are working toward the same goal.
takeaways.zh: 他們的方法不同，但撇開表面差異，仍朝着同一目標努力。

takeaways.en: Underneath it all, both speakers care about keeping the tradition alive.
takeaways.zh: 撇開表面差異，兩名發言者都關心延續這項傳統。
